Boxplot Layer Processor

Source: R/ggplot2_boxplot_layer_processor.R
Ggplot2BoxplotLayerProcessor.Rd

Processes boxplot layers (geom_boxplot) to extract statistical data and generate selectors for individual boxplot components in the SVG structure.

Ggplot2BoxplotLayerProcessor$get_built()

Get (and cache) the built plot data

ggplot_build() is expensive; extract_data, generate_selectors, determine_orientation, and map_categories_to_names all need it, so build at most once per processor instance.

Usage

Ggplot2BoxplotLayerProcessor$get_built(plot, built = NULL)

Arguments

plot

The ggplot2 object

built

Optionally a pre-built plot to adopt

Returns

Built plot data
